transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, it's real good to meet you too, Doctor. Thank you for fitting me in, I know you folks are awfully busy. 

Um... well, my family actually brought me in today. It was, I guess, just a bit of a misunderstanding down at the agricultural fair. I don't want you to think I'm a troublemaker or anything, I promise I'm not. I was giving my talk, and... well, I got a little carried away and climbed up onto the tractor. I just wanted to show the crowd this, uh, this 'new pattern' I'd been working on. So I was jerking the controls around a bit to demonstrate. 

People started yelling for me to get down, and... well, I'm a little embarrassed to admit it, but I just couldn't make myself stop doing it. Even with all the hollering. It sounds foolish now, I know. I hope I'm explaining that okay for you? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you been feeling unusually high or overly excited lately?

Well, I wouldn't say "unusually high," Doctor. I mean, I've always been a cheerful sort of fellow. But... well, I suppose there have been some mornings lately where I just wake up feeling real, real good. Like the whole valley is just opening right up for me, you know? And I'll catch myself just grinning at absolutely nothing. I hope that doesn't sound too strange? It's just a nice feeling. 

But, um... well, I guess I should mention, since you're asking, that I have been a little... touchy, maybe? Just a bit. Like, if one of the hired hands questions how I'm doing things, or if my wife tells me I need to slow down, I... well, I snap at them. Like they've insulted the family name or something. I always feel terrible about it after, I really do. I'm not a mean person, Doctor, I promise. I don't know why I get so fired up. Does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your question the way you need me to.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

Well, you know how it is on a farm, Doctor. There's always a lot of chores to be done. I don't want you to think I'm neglecting my health or anything—I've always been an early riser and a hard worker. 

But... well, I suppose lately I haven't been needing quite as much shut-eye as I used to. Most nights, I just kind of doze off in my armchair for maybe two or three hours. And some nights, to be perfectly honest, I don't sleep at all. But I don't feel tired, I promise! I'm up way before the sun, feeling completely charged up and ready to work the whole place like nothing even happened. 

I've been getting a lot done, actually, so I thought it was a good thing. But... well, my wife worries it's not right to run on so little rest. I hope I'm not doing something wrong by staying up like that? Is that the kind of information you needed me to tell you?
How long have you been feeling this unusually energized and keyed up?

Well, gosh, when you put it like that... I want to make sure I'm giving you the right timeline, Doctor, so you can do your job properly. I guess... well, if I'm really being honest, it's been going on for a good while. 

I don't want you to think I've just been running wild this whole time, I really haven't. But these stretches where I'm just so charged up, not sleeping, going nonstop... I suppose if I added it all up, it's probably been about ten months out of this past year or so. 

I know that sounds like an awful long time to be carrying on like that. I hope you don't think less of me for letting it go on so long without coming in to see somebody. I just kept thinking it was a good thing, getting all that work done. Is it okay that I let it go on for that long? I hope that helps you understand what's been happening with me.
Have you had times lasting at least two weeks when you felt very down or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Well, no, Doctor, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I'm not a gloomy sort of person at all. I don't want you to think I sit around moping or anything like that. 

I mean, sure, farming has its tough seasons, and sometimes a fella gets a little tired, but... no, I haven't had anything like that. Two whole weeks of just feeling down and not wanting to do my work? No, sir. I always find something to keep me busy and keep my spirits up. I take a lot of pride in my place, you know? 

I hope it's alright that I don't have that problem. I know you're trying to figure out what's going on with me, and I want to give you all the right answers. But I just haven't felt that way. Is that okay?
During these energized periods, have you had beliefs or experiences that other people said were not true or not real?

Well, gosh... I don't want you to think I'm crazy or anything, Doctor. I really try to be a sensible man, grounded, you know? But... well, I suppose there were some things. 

During those months when I was hardly sleeping at all, just working day and night to push that farm expansion... well, I started noticing some strange things. I hope you don't judge me too harshly for this, but... I started hearing things. Like, voices. But they were coming from the irrigation lines out in the fields. And... well, I also started seeing things in the yield maps. Like warnings, I guess you could say. 

I know how that sounds, I really do. My wife told me it was just the exhaustion talking, and maybe she's right. I don't want to make a big fuss out of nothing. But I want to be completely honest with you so you can help me. Is it normal to have your mind play tricks on you like that when you're working so hard? I hope I'm not making things too complicated for you.
Have you ever heard those voices or seen those warnings during a time when you were not feeling especially energized or keyed up?

Well, I... I want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture here, Doctor. I know you're trying to put all the pieces together, and I want to be helpful. 

I guess... well, if I'm being completely honest, and I know I need to be... there were some times when I wasn't running so hot. You know, just a few quieter weeks here and there where I wasn't feeling all that energized or... or grand, I suppose you could say. Just regular days. But... well, gosh, this is hard to admit. Even during those quieter stretches, I... I still heard the irrigation lines talking to me. And I still really believed those yield maps had hidden warnings in them. 

I know that probably sounds awful, like I'm losing my grip or something. I hope you don't think I'm completely out of my mind for letting that go on. I just... I didn't know what to make of it. Is it okay that I'm telling you this? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to figure this all out.
